launch_mujoco_viewer: launch the MuJoCo Simulate GUI with a model and data for interactive visualization
launch_passive_viewer: launch a non-blocking MuJoCo viewer handle with model, data, and optional key callback
launch_from_path_viewer: launch the MuJoCo viewer from an MJCF or MJB file path
handle_set_texts: set overlay text on the MuJoCo viewer with font, grid position, and text columns
handle_set_images: set overlay images on the MuJoCo viewer with viewport rectangles and RGB image arrays
